scope: local same-machine diagnostic; native fsync single host, warm OS cache; no hosted/AWS/SOTA or pricing claim

info.name: native-record
info.durability: native sealed Store sync=true; one durable append per <=1000 records; one host, no replication/backups
notes: actual native RecordLog and shared projection; current snapshot materialization, row validation/refresh, original reads and excerpts are inside each search
source IDs/known-at clocks and metadata persist as explicit benchmark import attributes; seconds convert to native microseconds; native assigned IDs/ingest clocks remain genuine and unchanged
native local Store compression/encryption differs from hosted per-object Zstd/S3/KMS; public fixture key, no hosted footprint/cost or failure-domain claim
RecordLog Store defaults: hot Zstd 3, dictionary cap 512KiB trained after 4MiB, hot-file target 64MiB, decode cache 4MiB; no explicit cold compaction in this arm

derived in-memory postings reuse requires a complete fresh view and identical retained rows; changes/removals rebuild; no disk index; native 100k-record/128MiB state bounds apply; >1000 input batches can recover partially before ACK
